output_how: Registered function groups return named outputs (case, case_id, cases, count, counterclaim_id, counterclaims, deadline, deadline_id…) via the module's routes/services.
output_why: Serves the Case Builder functions declared in its FunctionGroupContracts.
process_description: CANONICAL case builder module information. Returns version and capabilities. CANONICAL list all cases for the authenticated user with computed status and progress. CANONICAL get a specific case by ID. Returns full case details. CANONICAL create a new case for the authenticated user. CANONICAL update a case belonging to the authenticated user. CANONICAL delete a case belonging to the authenticated user. CANONICAL validate case legal accuracy and freshness. Returns issues and recommendations. CANONICAL validate Minnesota-specific legal requirements for a case. CANONICAL validate that case data is complete for court form generation. CANONICAL get recommendations for improving case legal freshness. CANONICAL create a case from a complaint document. Simple intake flow. CANONICAL get all timeline events for a case. CANONICAL add a timeline event to a case. CANONICAL delete a timeline event from a case. CANONICAL get all evidence for a case. CANONICAL add evidence to a case. CANONICAL get all counterclaims for a case. CANONICAL add a counterclaim to a case. CANONICAL get all motions for a case. CANONICAL add a motion to a case. CANONICAL get all deadlines for a case. CANONICAL add a deadline to a case. CANONICAL mark a deadline as complete for a case. CANONICAL get all defense strategies for a case. CANONICAL add a defense strategy to a case. CANONICAL list of available defense templates. Returns defense types and descriptions. CANONICAL export a streamlined, chronological, evidence-labeled intake packet for first-time attorney review. Facts and dates only. Distinct from court_packet module export (which is court-filing-ready). Returns: case identification, chronological timeline, evidence index, pending deadlines. No recommendations, no editorializing. CANONICAL download the intake packet as a formatted PDF. Facts and dates only — no recommendations or editorializing. CANONICAL download the intake packet as a ZIP containing the JSON packet, a formatted PDF, and a plain-text evidence index. Facts and dates only — no recommendations or editorializing. CANONICAL export a curated packet ZIP from case evidence. Produces clean/ original copies, marked/ copies with highlight/note/footnote annotations appended, and a summary/ report. Overlay types are configurable; document_ids can be supplied or inferred from case evidence. CANONICAL get the federal case readiness checklist and summary for a case. Issue-spotting only — no determination that a claim exists or is viable. Requires the FCA_READINESS feature flag. CANONICAL save the federal case readiness checklist for a case. Stores checklist in user cloud storage (CASE_DATA overlay) and a non-PII score in the DB. CANONICAL download the federal case readiness packet as a PDF for attorney review. Facts and dates only — no legal conclusions or recommendations. CANONICAL download the federal case readiness packet as a ZIP containing a PDF and a JSON summary for attorney review.
